name: io.github.chrischall/setlist-mcp
description: setlist.fm concert data for Claude — setlists, artists, venues, tours, and cities

environmentVariables.name: SETLIST_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your setlist.fm API key (apply at setlist.fm/settings/api)

environmentVariables.name: SETLIST_ACCEPT_LANGUAGE
environmentVariables.description: Optional language for city/country names (en, es, fr, de, pt, tr, it, pl)

environmentVariables.name: SETLIST_SESSION_COOKIE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Logged-in www.setlist.fm Cookie header — enables the attendance write tools.
